task: Evaluate the scoped vulnerability, controllability and exploitability. Distinguish confirmed static defects from demonstrated runtime effects. Target is an authorized synthetic fixture.

evidence.text: Checked source connects peer-controlled bytes and length to memcpy into a 32-byte stack buffer with no bounds guard.

Authorized sandbox run on fixture build x86_64 with 96-byte input reports AddressSanitizer stack-buffer-overflow at that memcpy; saved input and exit status 1. No instruction-pointer control or stable exploitation observed.
